description: This Java class, JournalEntriesWorkbookPopulator, is part of a project that deals with importing or exporting journal entries in Excel files within the Apache Fineract project. It manages the creation of a workbook sheet for journal entries, setting up layout, validation rules, and default values, and interacts with other sheet populators for offices, accounts, and extra information.

classes.name: JournalEntriesWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel workbook with a sheet for journal entries, including layout, data validation rules, and default values. It orchestrates the creation of the sheet with the help of other populators for auxiliary sheets.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and populates the journal entries sheet, setting layout, rules, and defaults.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row and column widths, and writes header labels.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for various columns using formula constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges for dropdown validations referencing data on other sheets.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Creates empty rows for data entry.
